description: This file defines the 'Source' interface for the Eclipse Ditto project, representing a configuration component that consumes external messages, including methods for addresses, authorization, payload and header mappings, acknowledgements, and reply handling.

classes.name: Source
classes.description: An interface representing a message source configuration in Eclipse Ditto, with methods for retrieving addresses, authorization, payload/header mappings, acknowledgements, reply targets, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: Source.JsonFields
classes.description: A final class containing definitions of JSON fields used in the Source configuration, such as addresses, consumer count, qos, enforcement, acknowledgements, header and payload mappings, reply target, and acknowledged labels.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Returns the set of addresses associated with this source.

methods.name: getConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers (connections) to be opened to the remote server, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the authorization context for this source, which overrides the connection-level context if set.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns an index to distinguish between sources.

methods.name: getQos
methods.description: Returns an optional QoS value applicable for certain connection types.

methods.name: getEnforcement
methods.description: Returns optional enforcement options for this source.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementRequests
methods.description: Returns optional acknowledgement requests with filters for messages consumed from this source.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Returns optional header mapping configurations for inbound messages.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns payload mappings to be applied to messages received on this source.

methods.name: getReplyTarget
methods.description: Returns an optional reply target for handling command responses.

methods.name: isReplyTargetEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether reply-target is enabled for this source.

methods.name: getDeclaredAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Returns the set of acknowledgement labels this source is permitted to send.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the source to a JSON object including non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Serializes the source to a JSON object with specified schema version and field selector.
